resources.string: An ASIC turns essentially all the electricity it draws into heat. In heating season, that heat offsets what you\'d otherwise spend to warm the space — so the power isn\'t a pure mining cost. Figures are estimates from live fleet power.
At the current draw, sustained for 24 h
Set your electricity rate in Settings to see the heat\'s cash value.
≈ %1$s days at the current rate of draw
If you heat with a heat pump instead
A heat pump (COP ≈ 3) makes the same heat for about a third of the electricity, so the miner offsets roughly %1$s/month against one.
Off heating season the heat has no value and adds cooling load — pair this with Schedules to wind down in summer.
